- Update dialog: the recipe changes the Tool Bits in the document (a Preset on the 5mm Endmill; Diameter 4.8 mm and Length 45 mm on the 5mm Drill), so the library copies are the new values. The Job of the recipe also has its default Tool Controller; this one has no library match and gives no row.

The timer captures the page widget (the parent of groupBoxToolBitDrawing) and then rejects the editor, so the capture does not stop. I did not use the term Axis Velocity that the lint proposes. ADR-000 defines Axis Velocity as the maximum rate of one Machine axis, stored on the Machine as `max_velocity`. The *Horiz Rapid* and *Vert Rapid* properties are values of the Tool Controller, which ADR-000 calls "rapids". Axis Velocity would be a false statement here.
